profile.name: Gabriel Nascimento Gama
profile.title: Full Stack Dev
profile.bio: Technologist in Systems Analysis and Development from Faculdade FACINT (2025). Has professional experience in developing web and mobile applications, focusing on technologies such as JavaScript, React, Node.js, and Electron.js. Demonstrates interest in research and application of Artificial Intelligence for task automation, software engineering, and UI/UX design.
